title: Flying saucer observatory detection over Ottawa and the end of Project Magnet

tellings.quote: it happens a week later it happens on the 8th the thing comes flying over and I was talked to one of the guys who was in the building at the time and he said all the bells went off

plain: A UFO researcher, Grant Cameron, tells of Project Magnet, a Canadian government effort in the 1950s, tied to the engineer Wilbert Smith, that set up a station near Ottawa to detect flying saucers. He says that on August 8, 1954, a week after a forewarning linked to a woman named Frances Swan, something flew over and, according to a man who was in the building, all the alarms went off. Cameron ties this to the project being shut down, which, if true, would mean it was ended just after it caught something.
